# Advanced Curve Fitting

[Mathematics functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Browse fifteen functions for outliers, goodness, confidence/prediction intervals and coefficient estimation.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Advanced Curve Fitting**

Ouvre quinze fonctions pour les observations exclues, la qualité, les intervalles et les coefficients.

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Remove Outlier](../../math/fitting/remove_outliers.md) | Removes designated observations while preserving X/Y/weight association. Range removes boundary and outside points; limits are upper then lower. Index uses explicit zero-based indices. Only Range returns outlier_indices; absent weights remain an empty output. Variants: range, index. |
| [Goodness of Fit](../../math/fitting/goodness_of_fit.md) | Measures supplied predictions without refitting. SSE=sum(abs(w)*r^2); SST uses the unweighted Y mean; R-square=1-SSE/SST, possibly negative. RMSE=sqrt(SSE/DOF), default nonpositive DOF replaced by n-2. Constant observations require a diagnostic. Variants: default. |
| [Nonlinear Curve Fit Intervals](../../math/fitting/nonlinear_curve_fit_intervals.md) | Computes local confidence intervals for supplied model parameters; no hidden new fit. Uses the same strict native model callback, real observations, confidence level and typed error cluster; returns parameter half-widths. Variants: function. |
| [Linear Fit Intvl](../../math/fitting/linear_fit_intervals.md) | Computes confidence or prediction intervals for supplied slope/intercept without refitting. Prediction adds observation variance and has no delta-parameter ports. Variants: confidence, prediction. |
| [Exp Fit Intvl](../../math/fitting/exponential_fit_intervals.md) | Computes confidence or prediction intervals for supplied amplitude/damping in a*exp(b*x), without offset. No hidden refit; Confidence alone has parameter half-widths. Variants: confidence, prediction. |
| [Power Fit Intvl](../../math/fitting/power_fit_intervals.md) | Computes confidence or prediction intervals for supplied amplitude/power in a*x^b, without offset. Real domains are checked; Confidence alone has parameter half-widths. Variants: confidence, prediction. |
| [Gauss Fit Intvl](../../math/fitting/gaussian_fit_intervals.md) | Computes confidence or prediction intervals for supplied amplitude/center/standard_deviation, without offset. Standard deviation is not variance or FWHM. Confidence alone returns three parameter half-widths. Variants: confidence, prediction. |
| [Log Fit Intvl](../../math/fitting/logarithm_fit_intervals.md) | Computes confidence or prediction intervals for supplied amplitude/scale/base in amplitude*log_base(scale*x). Scale stays multiplicative; Confidence alone returns parameter half-widths. Variants: confidence, prediction. |
| [Poly Fit Intvl](../../math/fitting/polynomial_fit_intervals.md) | Computes confidence or prediction intervals from supplied ascending coefficients. Effective free-parameter count controls degrees of freedom; no hidden refit. Confidence alone returns coefficient half-widths. Variants: confidence, prediction. |
| [Linear Fit Coef](../../math/fitting/linear_fit_coefficients.md) | Estimates slope/intercept only, using the linear weighted/robust criterion. No invented curve, residue or bound ports. Variants: default. |
| [Exp Fit Coef](../../math/fitting/exponential_fit_coefficients.md) | Estimates amplitude/damping only, with no offset. Refine false uses weighted log-space estimation; Refine true performs observation-space nonlinear refinement. These are distinct calculations; refine defaults false. Variants: default. |
| [Power Fit Coef](../../math/fitting/power_fit_coefficients.md) | Estimates amplitude/power in a*x^b, without offset. No refine port is copied from Exponential Fit Coefficients. Domains and weighted criterion are checked. Variants: default. |
| [Gauss Fit Coef](../../math/fitting/gaussian_fit_coefficients.md) | Estimates amplitude/center/standard_deviation only; initial_guess has exactly these three fields, with typed NaN automatic estimates. No offset, curve or residue output is invented. Variants: default. |
| [Log Fit Coef](../../math/fitting/logarithm_fit_coefficients.md) | Estimates amplitude and multiplicative scale in amplitude*log_base(scale*x), not slope/intercept under different labels. Default base e; nonidentifiable zero amplitude is diagnosed. Variants: default. |
| [Poly Fit Coef](../../math/fitting/polynomial_fit_coefficients.md) | Estimates ascending polynomial coefficients only, with actual coefficient constraints and algorithm selection0..6. Negative degree and degree&gt;25 retain their explicit error/warning contracts, never fictitious success. Variants: default. |
